title: Blue Point Bible Church Wednesday Night Bible Study
description: Weekly in-person and online Bible study/praise/prayer with strong full preterist focus. Pastor Mike Miano often features or discusses teachings aligned with preterist leaders like Don Preston and others.

title: Eschatology of the Prophets – Gateway to Fulfillment Conference
description: Annual multi-day conference on fulfilled eschatology and prophetic interpretation, featuring speakers like Steve Magua, Tim Martin, Michael Miano, Zach Davis, Don K. Preston, and William Bell Jr. All-inclusive options with lodging/meals at retreat center. Strong full preterist alignment.
locationText: Toddhall Retreat and Conference Center, Columbia, IL (near St. Louis, MO)

title: Berean Bible Church Spring Bible Conference 2026: How Shall We Then Live?
description: Annual preterist-focused Bible conference with speakers including David Curtis, Michael Sullivan, and Gary DeMar. Explores implications of preterism for Christian living. Held in Chesapeake, VA area.

title: Revelation Conference at East Tennessee State University (Gracereach)
description: Full preterist conference hosted by Brad Robertson/Grace Reach focusing on Revelation and fulfilled prophecy. Held on university campus.
locationText: East Tennessee State University, Johnson City, Tennessee

title: Bible Prophecy / Preterist Conference - South Haven, Michigan
description: Preterist conference addressing objections to the preterist view. Speakers include Don K. Preston and others. Hosted at Church of Christ at Lakeshore.

title: Montana Wild Conference: The Eschatology of Genesis
description: Fulfilled eschatology conference with review sessions and ties to broader preterist thought. Featured speakers like Steve Magua and Tim Martin.

title: International Preterist Association Conference - Niagara Falls
description: Full preterist conference hosted by IPA/Ed Stevens focusing on past fulfillment. Part of a series of annual events/picnics turned conferences.

title: Philadelphia Prophecy Seminar: What Happened in A.D. 70?
description: Introductory full preterist seminar by Ed Stevens and others on AD 70 fulfillment. Hosted by local preterist group.

title: Baltimore Area Introductory Preterist Seminar
description: Ed Stevens presentation on Christ's promised return and AD 70 events as introduction to full preterism.

title: Zach Davis Patreon Live Sessions
description: Recurring live streams and member Q&A on Patreon covering preterist theology, often with guests like Tim Martin. Public YouTube videos supplement with introductions to preterism and responses to common objections.

title: All Things Fulfilled with William Bell
description: Weekly (or near-weekly) teachings and broadcasts on fulfilled Bible prophecy, resurrection, and covenant themes. Classic radio-style program now primarily on YouTube with deep dives into preterist eschatology.

title: The Burros of Berea Podcast
description: Conversational podcast hosted by Rick Welch with frequent full preterist guests (David Curtis, Bob Cruickshank, Mike Sullivan, Gary DeMar, etc.). Roundtables on preterist worldview, society, and eschatology.

title: Preterist Power Hour
description: Recurring discussions and interviews hosted under the Power of Preterism Network featuring Rick Welch, Michael Miano, Zach Davis, and others. Covers advancing preterist theology and responses to critics.

title: Morning Musings with Don K. Preston
description: Regular YouTube video series / musings responding to critics, teaching on Revelation, and preterist topics. Often functions as a live or recorded podcast-style format.

title: Zach Davis Preterism Teachings & Patreon
description: YouTube videos, introductions to preterism, and exclusive Patreon live sessions/discussions (often with Tim Martin). Strong educational focus on fulfilled eschatology.

title: The Gary DeMar Podcast / Bible Prophecy Under the Microscope
description: Ongoing podcast and video content from American Vision addressing preterism, partial-to-full views, and prophecy. Includes responses to futurist critiques.

title: Mike Sullivan Full Preterist Discussions
description: Appearances on podcasts (Burros of Berea, debates) and content from fullpreterism.com focusing on consistent preterism, Armageddon, and House Divided themes.

title: Covenant Creation Conversations with Tim Martin
description: Interviews and sessions linking Genesis to fulfilled eschatology. Featured in conferences and collaborative podcasts.

title: Berean Bible Church Sunday Services & Studies
description: Ongoing full preterist teachings by David Curtis and guests (including past appearances by William Bell, Bob Cruikshank, Rick Welch). Annual Spring Conference and archived sermon series on fulfilled eschatology.
